WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND st.store_id<900
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS rows_,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM s GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM s) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT min(sale_date) FROM s) mn, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM s) mx,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM s) loads,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE channel_code<>'ST') nonST,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0) nonpos

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsb, sum(returns_net) rn, count(*) days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.ns mine, c.ns ctl, m.ns-c.ns diff, c.days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.ns,0)) DESC, 1

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), per AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT calendar_date, is_trading_day FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2
), sales AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n JOIN per ON per.calendar_date=n.business_date GROUP BY 1
), tdays AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN per
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900 AND per.is_trading_day
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date<=per.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date>=per.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND per.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
  cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line x WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS ret_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line x WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS ret_distinct
FROM sales s JOIN tdays t USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank, store_id
